{{Top|leg}}
'''Dalet''' was a letter of the [[Common Sith]] alphabet. It most probably had the value of /D/. It was used to identify an [[Ordnance/Regional Depot/Legends|Ordnance/Regional Depot]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] known as [[Ord Dalet]].
